method.method_draft: Read the bar graph values by matching each bar height to the frequency grid: length 3 has frequency 7, length 4 has frequency 3, length 5 has frequency 1, length 6 has frequency 4, and length 7 has frequency 4. From the text, use that there are 19 people and the task is to find the median name length. Since 19 is odd, the median is the 10th value in the ordered list. Compute cumulative frequencies from smallest length upward: after length 3 there are 7 names, and after including length 4 there are 10 names, so the 10th value is length 4.

推理：共有 19 个人，19 是奇数，所以中位数是按从小到大排列后的第 10 个值。累计频数从最小长度开始算：长度 3 有 7 个；再加上长度 4 的 3 个后，累计为 10 个。因此第 10 个值落在名字长度 4 这一组，所以中位数是 4。

method.method_draft: Read the bar graph as grouped counts: 7 names have length 3, 3 names have length 4, 1 name has length 5, 4 names have length 6, and 4 names have length 7. Use the text to know there are 19 total names. Instead of building cumulative totals, use the balancing property of the median: with 19 values, 9 values should lie on each side of the middle value. Count values greater than 4 from the graph: length 5, 6, and 7 contribute 1+4+4=9 names. Count values less than 4: length 3 contributes 7 names, and there are 3 names equal to 4. Thus the middle value must fall among the 4-letter names, so the median length is 4.
